issues.description: Method RollerCoaster.getNumberOfLoopings(): The UML in problem_statement.md (lines 26-28) declares the attribute numberOfLoopings as int. The template file src/de/tum/in/ase/RollerCoaster.java contains no implementation for this class. The solution implementation (solution_repository/src/de/tum/in/ase/RollerCoaster.java, lines 12-14) provides a getter with signature public double getNumberOfLoopings() that returns (double) numberOfLoopings. This causes a mismatch between the attribute type (int) described in the UML and the getter return type (double) in the solution, which can confuse students about the correct return type and lead to inconsistent implementations or failing tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the getter return the same type as the attribute. Preferred fix: change the getter signature in RollerCoaster to `public int getNumberOfLoopings()` and return the int field `numberOfLoopings`. Alternatively, if a double return type is intended, update the attribute type in the class and the UML/problem statement to `double`.
